member.summary: Controls an ESPHome water-heater entity.

remarks.para: HasFields is a bitmask that determines which values ESPHome applies: Mode=1, TargetTemperature=2, deprecated combined State=4, TargetTemperatureLow=8, TargetTemperatureHigh=16, OnState=32, AwayState=64.

member.name: T:ESPHome.API.Client.Model.ZWaveProxyRequest
member.summary: Sends a Z-Wave proxy control request.

remarks.para: aioesphomeapi exposes SUBSCRIBE and UNSUBSCRIBE for normal client control.
Subscribe/unsubscribe acknowledgements are available from API 1.16 as ZWaveProxyRequestResponse; older peers are sent the request without waiting for an acknowledgement.
HOME_ID_CHANGE exists in the protocol but the supplied aioesphomeapi client does not expose a high-level helper for constructing its Data payload.

member.name: T:ESPHome.API.Client.Model.InfraredRFTransmitRawTimingsRequest
member.summary: Transmits raw infrared or radio-frequency timings through an ESPHome transmitter entity.

remarks.para: CarrierFrequency is in hertz. RepeatCount is the number of complete transmissions; 1 means transmit once.
Timings are signed microseconds: positive values are mark/TX-on durations and negative values are space/TX-off durations.
Modulation is ignored for infrared entities. For radio-frequency entities, use a modulation supported by the entity; value 0 is OOK in the supplied aioesphomeapi model.

member.name: T:ESPHome.API.Client.Model.SerialProxyConfigureRequest
member.summary: Configures UART parameters for one ESPHome serial-proxy instance.

remarks.para: Instance is zero-based. Baudrate is in bits per second.
StopBits must be 1 or 2 and DataSize must be 5 through 8; aioesphomeapi validates both before sending.
Configure acknowledgements are expected from API 1.16 and newer. Older peers are sent the request without waiting for an acknowledgement.

member.name: T:ESPHome.API.Client.Model.SerialProxyRequest
member.summary: Sends a simple serial-proxy control operation.

remarks.para: Only SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE, and FLUSH are valid outbound SerialProxyRequest.Type values.
CONFIGURE and SET_MODEM_PINS are acknowledgement identifiers only; api.proto states that sending either value in SerialProxyRequest.Type is an error answered with INVALID_ARGUMENT.
FLUSH has been acknowledged since this message was introduced. Other serial-proxy acknowledgements are sent from API 1.16.

member.name: P:ESPHome.API.Client.Model.SerialProxyRequest.Instance
member.summary: Zero-based serial-proxy instance index.

member.name: P:ESPHome.API.Client.Model.SerialProxyRequest.Type
member.summary: Outbound operation type. Only SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE, and FLUSH are valid here; CONFIGURE and SET_MODEM_PINS are acknowledgement-only identifiers.
